To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a novel neural network model, Binary Paragraph Vectors, that learns short binary codes for information retrieval.

(i) Binary Paragraph Vectors can learn state of the are distributed representations for documents; (ii) they can be used to perform fast information retrieval; (iii) binary paragraph vectors are competitive with other state of the art models; (iv) they can be applied in various transfer learning scenarios, where the documents in the test collection are unrelated to the training documents
binary paragraph vectors: (1) outperform autoencoder-based methods in terms of precision; (2) can be used in transfer learning settings; (3) can be used to quickly retrieve relevant documents.
